name: Russia–NATO
value: Missiles, drone in Polish airspace 20 Nov
summary: Poland says two Russian missiles and a drone entered its airspace on 20 Nov; NATO scrambled jets; no Article 4 found
state: Poland's defence minister said three objects, probably two missiles and a drone, violated Polish airspace overnight into 20 Nov, with a Kh-101 cruise missile coming down about 60km from the Ukrainian border; NATO scrambled aircraft and Prime Minister Tusk called it an apparent intentional provocation (Kyiv Post/TVP World). NATO's Secretary General was due in Warsaw on 21 Nov. No Article 4 request or direct clash was found, so Watch holds.
for_you: No change for the public in NATO countries. Follow national authorities if you live near Poland's eastern border.
rubric_hit: Missile and drone airspace violations = Watch

why: Direct Russia–NATO confrontation is the most likely path to a European war involving the UK.
